summary: This document defines additional MODP Diffie-Hellman groups for SSH that use SHA-2 hashes. It also updates RFC 4250 and updates RFC 4253 by correcting an error about checking the peer's Diffie-Hellman public key.

eli5.summary: SSH needs to agree on a secret with big numbers. This adds more choices of numbers and fixes a mistake in how one side checks the other's.

questions: which dh groups does ssh support
